design: paired, deterministic shuffled case order; alternating within-pair baseline/assisted order; identical material in both arms
outcome: correct action AND meaning/context preservation; naturalness reported separately
assisted: Jev memory/sense/register/action labels; high-confidence memory and clarification may bypass Qwen
fallback: invalid Jev response is logged and Qwen runs with no advice; failure latency remains included
latency: end-to-end per arm, all API stages included; excludes audio and playback; one warmup per arm excluded
review: two blinded AI raters; disagreement reported and adjudicated; not native human certification
